 Open Week Musings: The ACC
 Chris Coleman 
 Lead Analyst and Columnist 
 October 28, 2026 
 14 
 Can anyone topple Darian Mensah? (Miami athletics) 
 ACC teams have all played either seven or eight games, and we’ve got a pretty good idea of the pecking order right now. Sure, the middle of the league is a jumbled mess right now, but you can say the exact same thing for the SEC and Big Ten. That’s just how it is in the days of these big conferences.

 HokiesandHerd 
 October 29, 2026 at 9:40 AM
 The UVA downfall was predictable with all of the close games they won last season against bad teams in extremely lucky fashion at times. Simple regression to the mean. 
 VicDrit 
 October 28, 2026 at 11:27 PM
 Love the Pyrrhic victory reference! 
 ombandit 
 October 28, 2026 at 10:27 PM
 Do we KNOW the exact amount of BC's NIL or are we assuming (probably rightly so) that their funding is horrible? 
 Chris Coleman 
 October 29, 2026 at 9:48 AM
 NIL? No. I know they are at full revenue sharing this year, as opposed to last year. I don't know exactly what percentage of that is dedicated to football, and I don't now how much NIL they have to go on top of revenue sharing. 
 fosterD1 
 October 28, 2026 at 8:00 PM
 I’ve seen Miami play a couple times.
Just my opinion but I’m not sure they are as good as they were last season. Don’t get me wrong…they are a great team with big time guys but their schedule hasn’t been the toughest. I think ND will challenge them. Wake went toe to toe with them. 
Our guys will go down there and give them a game! 
 134686Hokie 
 October 28, 2026 at 4:20 PM
 Chris , In regards to the Cal game do you think it is possible that the nightmare trip that happened to the team had an effect ? Heck I know I would have been exhausted. They just looked so flat even the offense! 
 Chris Coleman 
 October 28, 2026 at 8:51 PM
 There's no way to know if it did or didn't, but the one thing I can say is that it didn't help. 
 NokieHokie 
 October 28, 2026 at 3:19 PM
 The ACC. It just sucks more. 
 Maroon Effect 
 October 28, 2026 at 7:25 PM
 Where is the like button here? Priceless. 
 HtownHokie 
 October 28, 2026 at 1:25 PM
 Nov 21 for the W 
 HtownHokie 
 October 28, 2026 at 2:08 PM
 what an amusing, literature-rich and acc-informational column this off-week: 
your one-liners and repeaters are whackadoodle good -
 ~ "probably never seen it because I’m sure it’s never happened."
 ~ "as st_andrew opines ..., are they just playing with their food?"
 ~ "One of those is not like the other two."
 ~ "go with their backup quarterback on November 28, because that hasn’t gone well for the Hokies thus far."
 ~ "Unless there’s an earthquake of historic proportions, Blacksburg will still be located east of the Mississippi ..." - i hope so, since i'll have 3 friends up from 757Htown that day to hopefully see 'stunnedfurred' lose hyperhandily.
great job as always! 
 IB4TECH 
 October 28, 2026 at 1:16 PM
 When I first read "Merrimack" I thought it was a generic name for a powder puff. 
 GO_HOKIES_GO 
 October 28, 2026 at 1:05 PM
 8-4 would be a great start to Franklin’s tenure as HC and a solid bowl win would really help with recruiting, supporters’ attitude, and fund raising. I am worried about the injuries and depth as the season winds down - there were a lot of guys limping late in the Clemson game (including QB1 and RB1). While I agree the Cal performance is puzzling, it is also true that NFL teams often struggle when they have cross-country road trips (although it is usually west to east) - maybe we can write that one off to insufficient runway length in Roanoke and poor charter service out of Greensboro? 
 HtownHokie 
 October 28, 2026 at 1:28 PM
 maybe the ucalbares and VT win out and we right the leftcoast wrong in Charlotte! 
can i get a second and an Amen?
